QuestInfo.name: [Gold Beach] Shrimpy Situation
QuestInfo.0: Why is Little Richie not back in #m120040000# with those shrimp already?
QuestInfo.1: Take down 50 #o3401007# monsters for Little Richie and his dog, Lil Willy.
QuestInfo.2: You took care of things for Little Richie... again. What a little weenie!

0.0: Lil Willy and Teeny Jenny are all tuckered out from our adventures away from the resort. Watching you catch all those shrimp was exhausting!\r\n#L0##bMaybe you should try actually catching them yourself.#l\n#k
0.1: Ah-ha... hahaha! Your jest has tickled my funny bone! Now I need a break from all this laughing.\r\n#L0##bSeriously?#l\n#k
0.2: I know, I will draw a picture most wonderful while Lil Willy and Teeny Jenny prance about on the warm sand! Will you do me a favor as payment for this masterpiece?

yes.0: Go and be my model! Fight with the #o3401007# creatures around this area and I will capture your very essence. You'll need to fight about fifty of them to give me enough time.

no.0: B-but, this is your chance to be captured forever in history!

yes.0: I have created what will surely be the ultimate in beach-related art. Now I must go and enjoy my lunch! You may thank me for preserving your likeness at another time.

mob.0: I need you to eliminate 50 #b#o3401007##k creatures in the #m120041500#. Only then will I have proper reference.
